text:
Talia: quick sync
We got a request from Orion (hw partner) for a private-offer that ties a 12m commit to a hardware co-sell credit + explicit renewal path. want pragmatic ops that won't blow up eng-billing. who can help scope? :wave:
Evan: happy to take pricing. my initial thought: keep tiers simple and make the hw credit redeemable as an invoice line (not a hidden wallet). way better for SI quoting and audit trails.
Priya: finance lean: invoice-credit. easier for revenue recognition. activation floor suggestion: $100k ARR to avoid low-touch churn.
Marco: SI POV: must expose a public SKU so resellers can include it in proposals. also add a 1-pager co-sell checklist link in the private-offer metadata.
Gemma: legal flags: add early-termination clawback for hw credits within 120 days, prorated; require mutual PR approval for any joint announcement. also include DPA if any co-marketing data is shared.
Talia: draft tiers (for discussion):
```
Tier 1: commit >= $750k/year => 30% platform discount + $150k hw invoice credit (one-time)
Tier 2: commit $300k-$749k => 18% discount + $45k hw invoice credit
Tier 3: commit $100k-$299k => 10% discount + $10k hw invoice credit
Activation floor: $100k ARR
HW credit expiry: usable against invoices within 12 months
Clawback window: 120 days prorated repayment; netting allowed
```
Evan: love simple slabs like that. ops ask: make the renewal incentive a post-renew invoice credit (3% of prior year spend) if customer renews >=80% of prior commit. keeps base pricing stable.
Priya: finance confirms post-renew credit as separate AR line item. need SKU mapping for base discount, onboarding credit, and renewal credit.
Marco: engineering/catalog requirements from SI side: include fields - partner_id, partner_sku, commit_amount_usd, term_months, discount_pct, credit_type ("invoice"|"wallet"), credit_amount_usd, credit_expiry_days, activation_floor_usd, clawback_days, restricted_listing_bool, si_playbook_url. make the partner_sku visible in the listing.
Gemma: legal to add standard fraud clause: "credits void if evidence of misuse/fraud" and a short clawback paragraph: "On early termination within 120 days, onboarding credits are repayable on a prorated basis unless otherwise agreed in writing."
Talia: launch cadence proposal: T-28 partner kickoff + SI enablement, T-18 engineering spec & finance sign-off, T-10 pilot with Orion + 1 SI customer, T = marketplace private-offer live + joint blog, T+21 co-sell webinar and metrics check.
Evan: prefer pilot at T-7 to shorten feedback loop. we can compress spec review if finance and legal fast-track.
Priya: add a finance checkpoint at T-12 to lock SKU postings and invoice templates.
Gemma: legal will need final PR clause by T-14. will draft now.
Talia: ops note: eng-catalog will also need tagging for partner-restricted listings + partner_id so marketplace UI can filter. Evan, can you include those fields in the offer spec?
Evan: will file spec with these fields and tag eng-catalog + eng-billing. also including an example marketplace body with partner_sku: `redwood.marketplace:orion-commit-v1`.
Marco: I'll draft the SI 1-pager and a fillable email template for co-sell. will post to this thread.
Gemma: uploading draft legal clause in next message.
legal-bot: uploaded file "orion_hw_credit_clawback_v1.docx" to the thread and created a review task assigned to Gemma.
Talia: next steps: Evan posts offer spec, Priya confirms SKU mapping and ARR floor, Marco preps SI playbook + pilot customer intro, Gemma finalizes legal clause. i'll consolidate and create the ADO card by EOD. :thumbsup:
Marco: pinging potential pilot (Aperture Systems) now. will update when they confirm.
Evan: spec filed and PRD card created; tagging eng-catalog and eng-billing.
Priya: finance locks activation floor at $100k ARR and requests expiry window 12 months for credit.
Gemma: legal posted a concise clause: "On early termination within 120 days, onboarding credits must be repaid pro rata; credits may be offset against outstanding invoices where applicable."
Talia: perfect. i'm putting together launch checklist and calendar invites. thanks team! :rocket:
